pages.title: 歡迎來到 Jardi
pages.description: 從第一次連接，到自在探索。一起認識你的 iPhone 虛擬定位工具。
pages.descriptionEn: Jardi is a Mac app for simulating your iPhone's location. Set coordinates, save favorite places, and follow custom routes with the installation and user guides.

pages.title: 下載安裝
pages.description: 準備 Mac 與 iPhone，完成安裝、權限與 USB 連接。
pages.descriptionEn: Download Jardi for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Follow installation, Developer Mode, USB connection, and first-location setup instructions.

pages.title: 介面介紹
pages.description: 認識狀態、主功能、歷史紀錄與提醒四大區塊。
pages.descriptionEn: Learn the Jardi interface: connection status, location and movement controls, history, saved places, and notification settings.

pages.title: 虛擬定位
pages.description: 飛經緯度、選擇世界景點與標籤座標，以及清除定位。
pages.descriptionEn: Set an iPhone location from your Mac using latitude and longitude, world landmarks, or saved coordinates. Learn how to clear the simulated location.

pages.title: 虛擬移動
pages.description: 方形螺旋、沿線移動與 Advanced 設定的互動示範。
pages.descriptionEn: Simulate iPhone movement with square spiral routes, line movement, and advanced options. Explore interactive examples and route controls in Jardi.

pages.title: 圖片座標工具
pages.description: 從圖片中的標記，整理出自己的座標與路線。
pages.descriptionEn: Use Jardi’s image coordinate tool to calibrate map images, detect markers, and organize coordinates into reusable routes.

pages.title: 通知與鈴鐺
pages.description: 讓小鈴鐺提醒你路線進度與連線狀態。
pages.descriptionEn: Configure Jardi notifications and the bell to follow route progress, movement completion, and iPhone connection status.

pages.title: 地點、路徑與備份
pages.description: 編輯常用地點，把喜歡的路線好好保存。
pages.descriptionEn: Manage saved places and routes in Jardi. Edit CSV files, organize location data, and back up your favorite coordinates and paths.

pages.title: 範例練習
pages.description: 從一個座標開始，練習三種日常操作。
pages.descriptionEn: Practice Jardi with step-by-step examples: set a coordinate, save a favorite place, and try simulated movement along a route.

pages.title: 常見問題
pages.description: 連不上手機、定位沒恢復？從這裡找答案。
pages.descriptionEn: Troubleshoot Jardi installation, iPhone USB connections, Developer Mode, simulated location, movement, and app updates.

pages.title: 關於 Jardi
pages.description: 一個讓定位與路線整理更簡單的 Mac 小工具。
pages.descriptionEn: Meet Jardi - Location Tool and its creator jardiniere_pkm. Learn about the Mac app, local data handling, and versioned documentation.

pages.title: 回報問題
pages.description: 整理技術問題、操作疑問與文件建議，建立一份清楚的回報。
pages.descriptionEn: Report a Jardi bug, connection issue, documentation problem, or feature suggestion. Include your app version and steps to reproduce the issue.

pages.title: 贊助支持
pages.description: 分享使用心得，陪 Jardi 一點一點成長。
pages.descriptionEn: Support Jardi development, share feedback, and help improve the iPhone location simulation tool and its documentation.
